If you register for 4x4 Blindfolded and are not within the first 16 people registered, your registration for the event will be removed. However we will be keeping a waiting list for this specific event in the case of dropouts before the competition's registration period closes. Please only consider registering for this event if you are certain you would like to compete in it.
